title: Metadata Record
description: Description of the metadata record of the dataset.

title.title: title
title.description: A name given to the metadata record.

language.title: language
language.description: A language used in the textual metadata describing titles, descriptions of the metadata record.

items.title: Language system
items.description: A system of signs, symbols, sounds, gestures, or rules used in communication, e.g. a language.

qualified_attribution.title: qualified attribution
qualified_attribution.description: Link to a description of a relationship between metadata record and agent with the specification of the role of agent in this relationship.

items.title: Resource attribution
items.description: Attribution is the ascribing of a Resource to an agent. It defines the responsibility of an agent to the resource in a given role.

attributed_agent.title: has attributed agent
attributed_agent.description: The agent attributed to the resource.

anyOf.title: Organization
anyOf.description: Represents a collection of people organized together into a community or other social, commercial or political structure. The group has some common purpose or reason for existence which goes beyond the set of people belonging to it and can act as an Agent. Organizations are often decomposable into hierarchical structures.

items.title: Identifier
items.description: Unique and resolvable identifier containing the notation and identifier scheme in the form of URI.

value.title: value
value.description: Value of the identifier within the given identifier scheme.

scheme.title: in scheme
scheme.description: Relation between the identifier and scheme in which it is defined and unique.

authorized.title: authorized
authorized.description: Specifies whether the identifier is authorized by the subject it represents.

alternate_name.title: alternate name
alternate_name.description: To specify the organizational name associated with the object

contact_point.title: has contact point
contact_point.description: Relevant contact information for the catalogued resource.

items.title: Contact details
items.description: Contact details such as telephone, e-mail address etc.

address.title: has address
address.description: To specify the components of the delivery address for the object

items.title: Address
items.description: A spatial object that in a human-readable way identifies a fixed location.

full_address.title: full address
full_address.description: The complete address written as a string.

po_box.title: post office box
po_box.description: A location designator for a postal delivery point at a post office, usually a number.

thoroughfare.title: thoroughfare
thoroughfare.description: The name of a passage or way through from one location to another.

locator_designator.title: locator designator
locator_designator.description: A number or sequence of characters that uniquely identifies the locator within the relevant scope.

locator_name.title: locator name
locator_name.description: Proper noun(s) applied to the real world entity identified by the locator. The locator name could be the name of the property or complex, of the building or part of the building, or it could be the name of a room inside a building.

address_area.title: address area
address_area.description: The name of a geographic area that groups Addresses.

post_name.title: post name
post_name.description: A name created and maintained for postal purposes to identify a subdivision of addresses and postal delivery points.

administrative_unit_level_1.title: administrative unit level 1
administrative_unit_level_1.description: The name of the uppermost level of the address, almost always a country.

administrative_unit_level_2.title: administrative unit level 2
administrative_unit_level_2.description: The name of a secondary level/region of the address, usually a county, state or other such area that typically encompasses several localities.

post_code.title: post code
post_code.description: The code created and maintained for postal purposes to identify a subdivision of addresses and postal delivery points.
